description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV app, which displays a home screen with a top menu and multiple horizontally scrollable content rails populated from API data. It handles UI setup, focus behavior, and navigation to other activities.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that renders the TV home screen, including a top menu and horizontally scrollable content rails populated from API data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and triggers UI setup and data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures focus behavior and click navigation for the top menu items.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Inflates content rails, manages their state, and populates with images and titles based on live data.
